$comment: TEMPORAL TEXT -- the seam between `crud.temporal_text_value` (Python) and `crud.temporal_text_sql` (SQL, two dialect arms). Both are scored against the `expected` recorded here rather than only against each other: engine-vs-engine alone stays green when both drift the same wrong way, and these two are built from constants that make drifting together the EASY mistake.

seam.why: PostgreSQL's own CAST(timestamptz AS varchar) renders in the SESSION's timezone and omits the fractional part when it is zero, so two servers holding one row would compare different text. The postgres arm exists to remove exactly that, and until 2026-09-05 nothing evaluated it: the only test ran on SQLite, where the `_default` arm is a plain CAST -- the arm that never had the problem.

compiled_sql.note: Recorded with literal_binds so the FORMAT STRING is visible: it rides as a bound parameter, and a compile without literal binds would score a placeholder and call a changed format identical.

cases.label: microseconds
cases.note: the ordinary shape: six digits, all significant

cases.label: whole_second
cases.note: PostgreSQL's own CAST omits the fraction when it is zero; the pin must not

cases.label: one_microsecond
cases.note: the smallest non-zero fraction - a five-digit render loses it

cases.label: aware_plus_nine
cases.note: normalised to UTC, so the text does not follow a session GUC

cases.label: aware_minus_five
cases.note: crosses the date boundary westward - a naive render reports the wrong DAY

cases.label: date_only
cases.note: a DATE becomes midnight, not a bare date

cases.label: midnight
cases.note: all-zero time; a format that trims would collapse this to the date

cases.label: year_boundary
cases.note: the largest fraction, at a rollover

cases.label: single_digit_parts
cases.note: every field needs zero-padding; %-style and unpadded renders differ here

passthrough.label: none
passthrough.note: NULL propagates: CAST and to_char both answer NULL, and a temporal column is never ''

passthrough.label: empty_string
passthrough.note: not a datetime, so it is not folded - the funnel is elsewhere
